:::{#sol-additive-product}

No.
For $\vx = (1, 0)$ and $\vy = (0, 1)$,
$\vx + \vy = (1, 1)$, so

$$
f(\vx + \vy) = 1 \cd 1 = 1,
\qquad
f(\vx) + f(\vy) = 1 \cd 0 + 0 \cd 1 = 0.
$$

These differ,
so $f$ does not satisfy @def-additive-function for this pair of inputs,
and $f$ is not [additive](#def-additive-function).

:::
